product: Claude (in the browser, with connectors switched on)
description: The same web assistant with connectors you switched on — a drive, a code host, a cloud account. Each connector is a boundary (the vendor holds the token, scoped as you scoped it) and each one is a row you granted by clicking. DERIVED from the assess library's web tree; which connectors is yours to name.

reach_names.host: what the drive connector is scoped to; not your machine
reach_names.tenant: the accounts you connected, as you scoped them

blocked.blocked_by: the browser — a tab reaches a drive over the network, not a disk
blocked.why: a browser tab; the connector reaches a drive, not a disk

grant.note: a cloud connector acts as you

grant.control: the connector's scope, held by the vendor
grant.note: a drive connector: your other files, as scoped
a mail or chat connector reads your mail

not_an_assessment: This describes a published deployment shape. It is not an assessment, an audit, a certification or a security review of any named product, and it carries no adjective and no score.

provenance.note: Promoted from profiles/anthropic/claude-web/connectors-on.json. The grant is the union of its tool rows; where two tools reach the same capability the WEAKEST barrier is kept, because the agent takes the easier path.
